source_item: Research Problems in Function Theory, Problem 3.30
answer: No noncircular smooth Jordan curve has finite-rank double-layer operator. Circles have rank one.
approach: Prior-literature classification with rigorous operator and function-space reduction.
original_rigidity_dependency: Shapiro planar finite-rank characterization as recorded by Khavinson–Putinar–Shapiro and Miyanishi–Suzuki; explicitly restated in Miyanishi Corollary 5.1.
